notes: capture_raw now holds an flock on the RAW directory (the pattern tools/local_data/intake.py uses), so only one worker captures at a time and the kernel releases the lock if a worker dies; while holding it, partials left by a killed worker are removed before capture. The queue scanId must be a non-bool integer in 1..10^10, matching the connector and the Site's topoScanId. Staging also retries ConnectionError, which is safe because the Site treats a re-PUT of identical bytes as alreadyPresent. The lock uses fcntl and is POSIX-only, like the existing intake writer lock.
